structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly samples processed (epochs×50k) times a per-sample cost affine in stage widths (c1, c2 dominate), a mild small-batch inefficiency, and ~35% savings scaled by low-res fraction, plus ~1.6 ms/step Muon overhead. Accuracy rises ~0.5pp per epoch, with width, Muon (+~1pp), light translate2 and label smoothing 0.1; cutout, translate4, random flip hurt; low-res fraction costs convexly (steep beyond 0.5).
